items.text: #Texans Pro Bowl defensive end Danielle Hunter (hamstring), running back Woody Marks (concussion protocol), wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) all not practicing, all expected to be out for Thursday night game vs. #Colts Jadeveon Clowney to step in again for Hunter, David Montgomery and Emari Demercardo for Marks. Same receiver personnel team utilized in #Browns game
items.signal: Marks out, Demercado and Montgomery to share RB duties
items.why: Aaron Wilson reported Woody Marks (concussion) expected out for Thursday vs Colts, with David Montgomery and Emari Demercado to handle the backfield.
items.implication: Increases opportunity for waiver target Emari Demercado to see significant snaps and touches in a favorable Thursday matchup.
items.opportunity: Consider adding Demercado if available; monitor practice and final inactives for volume share.
corroboration: Earlier posts confirming Marks in concussion protocol and out

items.text: 'We got to find more ways to get him the ball,' #Texans QB C.J. Stroud on Tank Dell
